# cloudminator_vm (Resource)

A virtual machine. `name`, `tags`, `size`, a larger `disk_gb` and `running` change in place; everything else (including shrinking the disk) replaces the VM.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cloudminator_ssh_key" "me" {
  name       = "me"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}

resource "cloudminator_vm" "web" {
  name      = "web-1"
  image     = "debian-13"
  size      = "2c-4g"
  disk_gb   = 40
  subnet_id = cloudminator_subnet.app.id
  ssh_keys  = [cloudminator_ssh_key.me.public_key]
  user      = "debian"

  user_data = <<-EOT
    #cloud-config
    packages: [nginx]
  EOT

  tags = {
    role = "web"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `image` (String) OS image id (see the `cloudminator_images` data source).
- `name` (String) Display name. Not unique and not part of the VM's identity.
- `size` (String) Instance size, e.g. `2c-4g` (see the `size` of `cloudminator_flavors`). On a running VM a resize takes effect at its next restart.

### Optional

- `disk_gb` (Number) Boot disk size in GB. Growing it is in place; shrinking it replaces the VM.
- `ip` (String) Fixed IPv4 address within `subnet_id`, outside the DHCP pool (e.g. `.2`–`.9`). Omit for DHCP.
- `org` (String) Organization slug. Defaults to the provider's `org`. Changing it forces a new resource.
- `project` (String) Project slug. Defaults to the provider's `project` (or `default`). Changing it forces a new resource.
- `region` (String) Region id. Defaults to the platform's first region, or the subnet's region when `subnet_id` is set.
- `running` (Boolean) Desired power state. Defaults to `true`.
- `ssh_keys` (List of String) SSH public keys (authorized_keys lines) installed by cloud-init.
- `subnet_id` (String) Place the VM on this tenant subnet (`cloudminator_subnet.id`).
- `tags` (Map of String) Key/value tags. Used by attribute-based access control, so a change can be denied if the new tags fall outside the caller's scope.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))
- `user` (String) Cloud-init login user.
- `user_data` (String, Sensitive) Cloud-init user-data. Treated as sensitive because it often carries join tokens.
- `zone` (String) Zone id within the region. Empty lets the platform choose.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) Address the platform reports for the VM.
- `gateway` (String) Subnet gateway resolved for a VM on a subnet.
- `id` (String) Server-assigned VM id (`vm-…`).
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase reported by the platform (`Running`, `Stopped`, …).
- `simulated` (Boolean) True when the platform served this from a simulated (non-production) backend: nothing real exists behind it.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a VM by organization, project and VM id.
terraform import cloudminator_vm.web acme/default/vm-0123456789abcdef01234567
```
